run_REINFORCE_training: run the Reinforce class to train a reinforcement learning agent using policy gradient with baseline and entropy regularization
create_REINFORCE_instance: create a Reinforce instance with a config dict, environment factory, and agent factory for RL training
compute_REINFORCE_loss: compute the REINFORCE loss including baseline loss, entropy loss, and average reward from sampled trajectories
review_REINFORCE_get_loss: review the get_loss method that calculates discounted cumulative rewards and policy gradient loss components
refactor_REINFORCE_run: refactor the run method training loop to support custom optimizers or different loss weighting strategies
